arm_order: cyclic rotation by the dialogue's ordinal in the dataset (ordinal % number of arms of the phase)

ours.harness: scripts/202_eval_mt_gqa_ours_order.py (the same writer and request calls, through scripts/209)

lifecycle_source: scripts/156 + 164 helpers, scripts/196 and scripts/209 (imported, not copied)
resume_policy: committed images skipped; inside an interrupted image complete dialogues are kept and the interrupted dialogue restarts at turn 1; unverifiable stores -> the image restarts
source_T1_capture: the image's first dialogue; per store kind, the first arm of that kind in the rotation; every arm still runs its own full-pixel T1 in every dialogue

store_kinds.impress_official: full visual KV + probe key copy, per-layer reordered (IMPRESS)

tokenization.legacy: tokenizer input = prompt (the path of every LLaVA-NeXT MT-GQA run up to 2026-11-22)
tokenization.official: tokenizer input = prompt with one space after <image>; the fast tokenizer then emits the original-LLaVA ids (tokenizer_image_token, slow legacy tokenizer); compared after every request
